ValidationRule.description: [Sheet row 70 / OppVR90] Type cannot change once Stage is Negotiation/BV/Booked/Setup/Closed. Rebuilt per IRM to check CURRENT StageName (not PRIORVALUE, which wasn't firing reliably).
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula:
AND( ISCHANGED(Type),
OR( ISPICKVAL(StageName, 'Negotiation'), ISPICKVAL(StageName, 'Booking Verification'), ISPICKVAL(StageName, 'Booked'), ISPICKVAL(StageName, 'Setup'), ISPICKVAL(StageName, 'Closed') ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Type is locked. You cannot change the Type once the Opportunity reaches the Negotiation Stage.
